# Disagreement Log — GTH_109

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 109
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 109 | "hidden in his field without knowing it" | "hidden without his knowing it" | "buried treasure in his field — and he didn't know it was there" | Unknowing: simple modifier vs. clause vs. PNEUMA adds "buried" |
| 2 | 109 | "went plowing and found" | "came and plowed it, and found" | "went out plowing and struck" | Discovery action: find vs. struck |
| 3 | 109 | "to whomever he wished" | "to whomever he chose" | "to anyone who asked" | Recipients of lending: wished/chose vs. anyone |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "hidden in his field without knowing it" (EMET), "went plowing and found" (simple and literal), and "to whomever he wished" (EMET — the finder's discretion, not open to anyone).
